models.name: emotion2vec+ large
models.training_source: EmoBox academic data is used for seed fine-tuning, followed by teacher pseudo-labelling and data iteration to large; this project counts those corpora as used through upstream training. Large also uses 42,526 h of industrial pseudo-labelled audio. This is distinct from a claim that every EmoBox corpus directly entered large encoder self-supervised pretraining

models.name: MERaLiON-SER-v1
models.training_source: SER training on CREMA-D, ESD, MELD, M3ED and Singaporean speech; retained Whisper-medium pretraining sources are incompletely disclosed; upstream seed/base teacher use is counted as seen

models.name: Melati
models.training_source: Public SER head trained on nine named corpora including JL-Corpus and Emozionalmente; Whisper-v3 pretraining incompletely disclosed; author nEMO threshold calibration is counted as seen development use, although its thresholds are not applied here

models.name: Vox-Profile Whisper
models.training_source: SER adaptation on MSP-Podcast v1.12; retained Whisper-large-v3 pretraining sources incompletely disclosed

models.name: Vox-Profile WavLM
models.training_source: SER adaptation on MSP-Podcast v1.12; WavLM-large backbone trained on Libri-Light, GigaSpeech and VoxPopuli; no clip-level overlap audit

models.name: Qwen2.5-Omni 7B
models.training_source: Qwen2.5 and Whisper-large-v3 initialization plus multimodal pre/post-training; complete corpus-level provenance not published

models.name: Qwen2-Audio 7B Instruct
models.training_source: Qwen-7B and Whisper-large-v3 initialization; report states evaluation-data exclusion, but full backbone and pre/post-training corpus provenance is unavailable

models.name: Gemma 4 E4B
models.training_source: Broad multimodal pretraining and instruction tuning; complete corpus-level provenance not published (Google)
